name: language-rooting-reconciliation
body:
Reconciliations of the existing spec with the language-rooting decision (each confirmed against the graph/source; every fix is recorded here per the source-spec workflow).

(1) Python module-FQN open point — RESOLVED. domain.value.module-fqn-prefix (4) and requirements.requirement.python-package-identity deferred the Python namespace form; it is now the language-rooted form `py.<dotted-identity>`. requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points #1 is marked DECIDED, and domain.entity.python-package aligned. The Python node was NOT removed — only its FQN form was pinned. [autonomous]

(2) module-fqn-prefix — UPDATED. The value now states the language root as the universal prefix and the per-meaning rendered forms; the Python identity is DECIDED; the markdown path-derived identities render as `md.<absolute-path>`. [autonomous]

(3) Markdown module-FQN statements — SUPERSEDED. requirements.requirement.markdown-sections-as-symbols and requirements.requirement.markdown-accept-extensions state a markdown Module FQN as the directory's absolute path; under language rooting it is `md.<absolute-path>`. The general rule (requirements.requirement.language-rooted-module-fqn, domain.value.module-fqn-prefix) supersedes the bare form; the markdown section scheme stays injective because the rooted module and the absolute-path file/section prefixes remain unique. The markdown File FQN stays the bare absolute path (files are not rooted). [autonomous]

(4) Per-language module identities — now `<module-identity>` under a root. The Cargo/npm package name, Go module path, Java package, and C++ namespace statements describe the identity, not the rendered FQN; every rendered module FQN carries its language root. [autonomous]

(5) domain.value.language-id — UPDATED: the id gains the FQN-root-prefix role (verbatim). New: domain.entity.language-root, domain.service.language-rooting, domain.service.rooted-fqn-migration, global.constraint.language-rooted-identity, and the local constraints. [autonomous]

(6) The markdown note requirements.note.markdown-frontend-open-points point 5 (root-directory naming) is unaffected: the repo-root markdown Module is `md.` + the repo-root absolute path, still always nameable. [autonomous]
